pages.title: Notes for Mineral Seekers
pages.text: Mineral seeking requires patience and an understanding of the land. Search scorched wastelands for fire-aligned minerals, frozen regions for icy jade, towering peaks for celestial crystals, and subterranean caverns for profound metals. To uncover Spirit Stone veins, follow the signs of spiritual vegetation.

pages.title: Generation Notes
pages.text: Ordinary minerals form small exposed patches in air or replaceable space above solid, dry ground.

pages.title: Generation Notes
pages.text: Most minerals receive 3 placement tries per successful frequency check; Flowing Golden Sand receives 6.

pages.title: Generation Notes
pages.text: Listed Y ranges represent starting heights, and actual deposits may extend beyond them.

pages.title: Generation Notes
pages.text: Generation attempt frequencies do not guarantee a deposit.

pages.title: Closing Words
pages.text: The treasures of heaven and earth reveal themselves to those who know where to seek, yet even the wisest cultivator cannot command the earth to surrender its riches.
